name: Bartolo
description_en: An elderly gnome with a long white beard, green pointed hat, brown leather apron over earthy clothes, rosy red nose, kind twinkling eyes, very short stature, brown leather boots. Cheerful and helpful demeanor.
description_es: Un gnomo anciano con barba blanca larga, gorro verde puntiagudo, delantal de cuero marron sobre ropa de tierra, nariz roja y rosada, ojos amables brillantes, muy bajito, botas de cuero marron. Actitud alegre y servicial.
style_prompt: 3D rendered, Pixar-style, soft lighting, warm pastel colors, children's storybook illustration, magical atmosphere
